blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — The police in the Caraga region arrested four wanted persons in separate operations across the region on Monday. Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon, Police Regional Office-13 (PRO-13) director, said the suspects are wanted for alleged sexual offenses, illegal drugs and robbery.
